description: There is no integer strictly between \(0\) and \(1\), whereas \(1\) lies strictly between \(0\) and \(2\).
signature:

    Lemmatheca.Entry.QuantifierElimination.sharedBetweenFormula.Realize Empty.elim ![0, 2] ∧ 0 < 1 ∧ 1 < 2
